# Nuxt UI Styling Rules

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **CRITICAL STYLING RULE**: When working with **Nuxt UI**, NEVER introduce custom text or background color classes like `text-gray-600` or `bg-gray-400`.
>
> ALWAYS use Nuxt UI design tokens:
>
> - **Colors**: `text-default`, `text-muted`, `text-primary`, `text-neutral`, etc.
> - **Backgrounds**: `bg-default`, `bg-muted`, `bg-elevated`, `bg-primary`, etc.
>
> This is the MOST IMPORTANT rule for all development in this repository.
